headline: Kulicke & Soffa Reports Fourth Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Kulicke & Soffa announced net revenue of $410.3 million for the fourth fiscal quarter ended October 3, 2026.
why: As a major supplier of semiconductor assembly equipment, Kulicke & Soffa's financial performance serves as a bellwether for the health of the semiconductor manufacturing supply chain.

impacts.name: Kulicke & Soffa
impacts.why: Earnings reports directly influence investor sentiment and stock price based on whether results meet or miss analyst expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Quarterly earnings results are primary drivers of stock price movement as they provide concrete data on company profitability and operational efficiency.
